recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀圖：上圖以低側向散射（SSC）、中等前向散射（FSC）圈出母細胞區（blast gate）；下圖母細胞同時表現 CD13 與 CD19。注意 CD13 屬非系別決定性標記，單靠它不足以診斷混合表型急性白血病（MPAL）。
features: Forward scatter vs side scatter dot plot with an R1 blast gate on the low-SSC, intermediate-FSC population
CD13 (PE) vs CD19 (FITC) plot of gated events
Dominant population in the upper-right quadrant coexpressing CD13 and CD19
Smaller double-negative population in the lower-left quadrant
No MPO, cytoplasmic CD79a or CD22 data shown
describe_en: Flow cytometry dot plots are shown. Blasts are gated in the low side scatter, intermediate forward scatter region (R1), and the gated population coexpresses CD19 and CD13, with a minor CD13-/CD19- population. This demonstrates a B-lineage blast population with aberrant expression of the myeloid-associated antigen CD13. Under current WHO/ICC criteria, CD13 or CD33 expression alone does not establish myeloid lineage; a diagnosis of B/myeloid mixed-phenotype acute leukemia requires MPO positivity (or monocytic differentiation) in addition to B-lineage markers, so these plots alone are most consistent with B-lymphoblastic leukemia with aberrant myeloid antigen expression.

ddx.dx: B-lymphoblastic leukemia with aberrant myeloid antigen
ddx.vs: CD13/CD33 coexpression is common in B-ALL (notably with ETV6::RUNX1 or BCR::ABL1) and does not change the diagnosis when MPO is negative.
Requires MPO expression (flow or cytochemistry) or clear monocytic differentiation in addition to strong CD19 with CD79a, CD22 or CD10.

ddx.dx: AML with aberrant CD19 (e.g., AML with RUNX1::RUNX1T1)
ddx.vs: Blasts are MPO-positive and usually only weakly or partially CD19-positive without cytoplasmic CD79a or CD22, and often show Auer rods morphologically.
